knowledge_base.question: What is CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: C. K. Pithawalla College of Commerce – Management – Computer Application (CKPCMC) is a self-financed college managed by the Navyug Vidyabhavan Trust in Surat, Gujarat. It is affiliated to Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (VNSGU) and offers undergraduate programs in B.Com, BBA, and BCA.

knowledge_base.question: Who manages CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC is managed by the Navyug Vidyabhavan Trust — a Public Education Trust registered under the Bombay Public Trust Act, 1950 (Reg. No. 1268). The Trust also manages CKPCET, Navyug Arts, Science and Commerce Colleges, and other institutions in Surat.

knowledge_base.question: Who is the founder of CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC was founded under the Navyug Vidyabhavan Trust by Late Shri Chhotubhai K. Pithawalla ('C.K.'). He was a visionary philanthropist from Surat who believed in making education accessible to all, regardless of caste, creed, or religion. The college is named in his honor.

Hostel admission and registration documents are available via the student section in the college office.

knowledge_base.question: What hostel rules are there?
knowledge_base.answer:
The CKP Campus hostel operates with strict discipline rules to ensure a safe and focused environment:

⚠️ Key Rules Include:
• Entry/exit timings strictly enforced
• Guests/visitors must register at the security desk
• Use of alcohol, tobacco, drugs is strictly prohibited
• Ragging is strictly prohibited and punishable
• Electrical appliances other than those permitted are not allowed

For the complete and current list of hostel rules and warden contacts, please visit the college office.

knowledge_base.question: What is the placement record at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC has a dedicated Training & Placement Cell that helps BCA, BBA, and B.Com students secure job opportunities and internships. Enrolled students are recruited by top companies, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, L&T, Concentrix, and various local business firms in Surat. The average package ranges from ₹2.5 LPA to ₹4.5 LPA.

knowledge_base.question: How does the placement process work at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: The Training & Placement Cell organizes year-round activities including resume-building workshops, interview preparation, and soft skills sessions. During the final year, recruiters conduct campus placement drives (including aptitude tests, group discussions, and personal interviews). Interested students can register with the placement office.

knowledge_base.question: What scholarships are available at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC helps students apply for various government scholarships, including SC/ST, SEBC, EWS, and minority scholarships via the digital Gujarat portal. Meritorious students can also apply for state-specific schemes like MYSY and CMSS. Contact the administrative office for documentation support.

knowledge_base.question: What is the MYSY scholarship scheme?
knowledge_base.answer: MYSY (Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana) is a Gujarat government scheme that provides financial assistance (up to 50% tuition fee waiver) to meritorious students who scored 80% or more in 12th standard, with a family income below ₹6 lakh per annum. Eligible students can apply via the official MYSY portal: https://mysy.guj.nic.in.

knowledge_base.question: What is the CMSS scholarship?
knowledge_base.answer: CMSS (Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme) is a Gujarat government initiative offering financial assistance to meritorious students from general/open categories with family income under specified limits. Application forms and updates can be accessed on the official state portal.

knowledge_base.question: Can I get an education loan at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes, CKPCMC provides the necessary institutional documents (such as fee structure and bonafide certificates) to help students secure education loans from nationalized and private banks. For assistance, contact the administrative office at 9023437774.

knowledge_base.question: What is the refund policy for fees at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: Fee refunds at CKPCMC adhere strictly to VNSGU guidelines. The amount refunded depends on when the admission withdrawal is requested relative to the start of the academic semester. For the detailed refund schedule, please contact the college administration office at ckpcmc@gmail.com.

knowledge_base.question: Is Wi-Fi available on campus at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes, the CKP Campus (including CKPCMC classrooms, computer labs, library, and common areas) is equipped with free high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity for students and faculty. Credentials can be obtained from the computer lab administrator upon enrollment.

knowledge_base.question: Is there a student council at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes, CKPCMC has an active Student Council consisting of student representatives. The council acts as a liaison between the student body and college administration, helping organize cultural, technical, and sports events, and addressing student concerns.

knowledge_base.question: Is there a women's helpline or safety cell at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes, the campus features a Women Development Cell and an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to ensure safety. A dedicated Women's Helpline is active at +91 90990 63009 for any safety or security-related concerns.

knowledge_base.question: What is the grievance redressal system at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC maintains a transparent grievance system including a Student Grievance Redressal Cell, Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), and an Anti-Ragging Committee with zero tolerance for ragging. Concerns can be submitted to the HOD or by email to ckpcmc@gmail.com.

knowledge_base.question: What is NCC / NSS at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: CKPCMC has an active National Service Scheme (NSS) unit focusing on community service, environmental drives, and social welfare programs. Regular NSS camps are organized. For voluntary military training, students can also apply for NCC programs in collaboration with sister colleges. Contact the NSS coordinator for enrollment.

knowledge_base.question: Who is the Principal of CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer: The Principal of CKPCMC is **Dr. Chetan Patel** (Ph.D., M.Phil., M.Com., B.Com.). Under his leadership, the college focuses on academic quality, career development, and co-curricular programs.

knowledge_base.question: What is the eligibility criteria or requirements for admission to B.Com, BBA, and BCA at CKPCMC?
knowledge_base.answer:
Admission eligibility criteria for CKPCMC programs under VNSGU guidelines:
• **B.Com / BBA**: Passed 12th (HSC) in any stream (Commerce, Science, or Arts) from a recognized board with English as a compulsory subject.
• **BCA**: Passed 12th (HSC) in any stream from a recognized board with English and either Mathematics, Statistics, Business Mathematics, or Computer Science.

All admissions are merit-based.
